dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans enrolled in VA healthcare and participating community organizations at pilot locations.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a pilot program under which the Secretary shall establish a new, or enhance an existing, interoperable community integration platform

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a pilot program across at least five medical facilities and mandates routine collection of social determinants of health data.
dimensions.evidence: carry out the pilot program at not fewer than five medical facilities of the Department of Veterans Affairs.

dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Health and Human Services... shall issue guidance to States that includes options for State Medicaid programs

dimensions.assessment: Operates as a pilot program with required reports and evaluations submitted to Congress within three to four years.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than three years after amounts are first appropriated... submit to Congress a report
